description:
## 0.0.22-8 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22, synced with SysAdminDoc/HushGram up to 634cb4994. For Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* Full glass chat top bar: a glass ring round the chat's avatar, and the name, status and icons turn white over a dark, colourful or photo chat theme. Switches under HushGram settings > Messages > Glass top bar in chats.
* With white text, the chat's round buttons take clearer glass with a bright rim.
* Also in this build: Translate chat messages, Glass sheets, the chat top bar's sheen, frost and lit rim, and the Reels seek bar fix.
